text: Killing Eve ran for 4 series of 8 episodes each. How many episodes is that altogether?
A 60-minute episode of Spooks starts at 9:00pm, and the news follows it 5 minutes later. What time does the news start?
The assassin in Killing Eve is called VILLANELLE. Count its distinct letters: how many is that?
why: V, I, L, A, N and E.

text: Sherlock, Luther and Morse each own one of a violin, a coat and a Jaguar. Sherlock owns neither the coat nor the Jaguar, and Luther doesn't own the coat. Who owns the coat?
why: Sherlock has the violin; Luther isn't the coat, so he has the Jaguar; that leaves the coat for Morse.
